steps.title: Orient the engine-side face
steps.text: Two vertically arranged contacts sit inside an illustrative asymmetric shroud. Viewed from +X toward -X with +Z up, control is above VPWR. The separate harness-face drawing must not be copied unmirrored.

troubleshooting.title: Open or bridged connection
troubleshooting.text: The geometric controls disconnect a lead tail or bridge the two contacts. They explain faults without claiming measured resistance, dielectric strength or a repair procedure.

iac-coil.summary: Follow the circuit, not the envelope material

steps.title: Follow the circuit, not the envelope material
steps.text: The exact1994 circuit has a winding and parallel suppression diode between VPWR and PCM control. The diode cathode is on VPWR. No physical package, turns or resistance are simulated.
